package com.m3.collections;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Immutable 256-bucket statistics for M3's unsigned-byte object-state metadata.
 *
 * <p>Sources retain ownership of values, object references, slot generations and
 * metadata. This class captures only occurrence counts; duplicate offsets are
 * counted once per encounter, even when they name the same physical slot.
 * Indexed capture follows {@code first + ordinal * stride} over a borrowed
 * {@code int[]} offset plane, then reads its {@code byte[]} state plane.
 * Aligned capture instead traverses a byte lane directly. Both permit reverse
 * and strided windows, with all bounds validated before building a result.
 *
 * <p>Counts are exact for a stable input during capture and do not subsequently
 * track a live collection. Queries use an eight-bit superset-sum transform and
 * inclusion-exclusion, so required-only queries are O(1), and combined masks
 * cost O(2^popcount(forbidden)), at most 256 integer operations. Capture is O(n)
 * plus O(8*256), with exactly two retained int[256] arrays; no boxed counts,
 * Map.Entry nodes, object graph traversal or extra owner of the payload.
 *
 * <p>The opt-in native backend scans aligned <em>primitive state bytes only</em>,
 * in bounded JNI regions. Indexed native capture first constructs a transient
 * aligned metadata byte lane on the Java side, never sending a Java object,
 * comparator, predicate or GC pointer to C. Native is not automatically faster:
 * the Java backend avoids this indexed realignment. No automatic fallback from
 * NATIVE_REQUIRED and no new JDK collection or serialization contract is claimed.
 */
public final class M3StateMaskHistogram {
    public enum Backend { JAVA, NATIVE_REQUIRED }
    private static final int STATES = 256;
    private static final boolean NATIVE_AVAILABLE = loadNative();

    private final int[] exact;
    private final int[] supersets;
    private final int total;
    private final int distinct;

    private M3StateMaskHistogram(int[] histogram, int total) {
        this.exact = histogram;
        this.total = total;
        this.supersets = histogram.clone();
        int seen = 0;
        for (int count : histogram) if (count != 0) seen++;
        this.distinct = seen;
        for (int bit = 1; bit < STATES; bit <<= 1) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < STATES; mask++) {
                if ((mask & bit) == 0) supersets[mask] += supersets[mask | bit];
            }
        }
        if (supersets[0] != total) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("state histogram tally disagrees with input cardinality");
        }
    }

    /** Whether the optional dedicated primitive JNI library could be loaded. */
    public static boolean nativeAvailable() { return NATIVE_AVAILABLE; }

    /** Count occurrence states through a caller-owned, possibly strided byte lane. */
    public static M3StateMaskHistogram aligned(byte[] stateBytes, int first,
            int count, int stride, Backend backend) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stateBytes, "stateBytes");
        Objects.requireNonNull(backend, "backend");
        requirePath(first, count, stride, stateBytes.length);
        int[] buckets = new int[STATES];
        if (backend == Backend.NATIVE_REQUIRED) {
            requireNative();
            tallyNative(stateBytes, first, count, stride, buckets);
        } else {
            long at = first;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++, at += stride) {
                buckets[stateBytes[(int) at] & 0xff]++;
            }
        }
        return new M3StateMaskHistogram(buckets, count);
    }

    /**
     * Count occurrences through physical slot offsets without moving payloads.
     * Every addressed offset is validated before any native processing begins.
     * Neither input array is retained; an indexed JNI call allocates only a
     * temporary byte sequence aligned to this path and no Java object wrappers.
     */
    public static M3StateMaskHistogram indexed(int[] physicalOffsets, byte[] physicalStates,
            int first, int count, int stride, Backend backend) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(physicalOffsets, "physicalOffsets");
        Objects.requireNonNull(physicalStates, "physicalStates");
        Objects.requireNonNull(backend, "backend");
        requirePath(first, count, stride, physicalOffsets.length);
        long at = first;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++, at += stride) {
            Objects.checkIndex(physicalOffsets[(int) at], physicalStates.length);
        }
        if (backend == Backend.NATIVE_REQUIRED) {
            requireNative();
            byte[] aligned = new byte[count];
            at = first;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++, at += stride) {
                aligned[i] = physicalStates[physicalOffsets[(int) at]];
            }
            return aligned(aligned, 0, count, 1, Backend.NATIVE_REQUIRED);
        }
        int[] buckets = new int[STATES];
        at = first;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++, at += stride) {
            buckets[physicalStates[physicalOffsets[(int) at]] & 0xff]++;
        }
        return new M3StateMaskHistogram(buckets, count);
    }

    public static M3StateMaskHistogram indexed(int[] physicalOffsets, byte[] physicalStates,
            int first, int count, int stride) {
        return indexed(physicalOffsets, physicalStates, first, count, stride, Backend.JAVA);
    }

    /** Exact count of original logical occurrences, including duplicated offsets. */
    public int size() { return total; }

    /** Number of distinct unsigned state-byte values seen (0..256). */
    public int distinctStates() { return distinct; }

    /** O(1) count whose state byte equals this unsigned value. */
    public int countExactly(int state) {
        requireMask(state);
        return exact[state];
    }

    /**
     * Count states containing every required bit and no forbidden bit.
     * Overlapping masks, as in M3IndexMaskWindow, select no occurrences.
     * Supermask inclusion-exclusion avoids scanning input rows again.
     */
    public int countMatching(int requiredMask, int forbiddenMask) {
        requireMask(requiredMask);
        requireMask(forbiddenMask);
        if ((requiredMask & forbiddenMask) != 0) return 0;
        if (forbiddenMask == 0) return supersets[requiredMask];
        long count = 0;
        int bits = forbiddenMask;
        for (int subset = bits;; subset = (subset - 1) & bits) {
            int matches = supersets[requiredMask | subset];
            count += (Integer.bitCount(subset) & 1) == 0 ? matches : -matches;
            if (subset == 0) break;
        }
        return Math.toIntExact(count);
    }

    /** Defensive caller-owned copy, never the private histogram array. */
    public int[] exactCounts() { return Arrays.copyOf(exact, exact.length); }

    /** Primitive retained array payload only, excluding Java array headers. */
    public int retainedPrimitiveBytes() { return 2 * STATES * Integer.BYTES; }

    private static void requirePath(int first, int count, int stride, int length) {
        if (first < 0 || first > length || count < 0 || stride == 0) {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("invalid state-path geometry");
        }
        if (count == 0) return;
        long last = (long) first + (long) (count - 1) * stride;
        if (first == length || last < 0 || last >= length) {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("state-path escapes source window");
        }
    }

    private static void requireMask(int mask) {
        if ((mask & ~0xff) != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("state mask must fit unsigned byte");
        }
    }

    private static void requireNative() {
        if (!NATIVE_AVAILABLE) {
            throw new UnsatisfiedLinkError("m3_collections_statehist JNI library unavailable");
        }
    }

    private static boolean loadNative() {
        try {
            System.loadLibrary("m3_collections_statehist");
            return true;
        } catch (UnsatisfiedLinkError | SecurityException unavailable) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static native void tallyNative(byte[] stateBytes, int first,
            int count, int stride, int[] buckets);
}
